description: Resolve one identifier across openFDA, CosIng, RxNorm, DrugCentral, DailyMed, DSLD, INKEEDecoder, and PubChem. Pass exactly one of unii, ndc, rxcui, cid (PubChem compound id), cas, inci_name, substance_name, spl_setid, or dsld_id. Ingredient identifiers return an identity graph of confident cross-source links with labeled candidate sets for ambiguity; product identifiers (ndc, spl_setid, dsld_id) return the product's cross-source links plus its ingredient rows. `include_label_ingredients` parses SPL XML for ingredient UNIIs — extra request, default false. `resolve_ingredients` runs the full resolution per ingredient — many requests on multi-ingredient products, default false — and returns graphs for a prefix of the ingredient rows, capped at 20. `max_candidates` caps the options per ambiguous source result. Results carry a compact confidence count and suggested follow-up calls. An identifier of the wrong shape is an error result naming the search tool that finds a valid one; zero matches are ordinary and in-band.

cas.description: CAS Registry Number in dashed form, for example "50-78-2".

cid.description: PubChem compound identifier — a positive safe integer, for example "56843331".

dsld_id.description: NIH DSLD label id — a positive integer, as a number or digits.

inci_name.description: INCI (cosmetic ingredient) name; a name lookup, not an exact identifier.

include_label_ingredients.description: Parse SPL XML for ingredient UNIIs — extra request, default false.

max_candidates.description: Maximum candidate options kept per ambiguous source result, 1-10. Default 5.

ndc.description: National Drug Code — a 10- or 11-digit package NDC or a labeler-product NDC such as "00093-1046".

resolve_ingredients.description: Runs full resolution per ingredient — many requests on multi-ingredient products, default false.

response_format.description: Text format: 'markdown' for a readable identity report, or 'json' for the structured result serialized as JSON.

rxcui.description: RxNorm concept identifier — numeric, for example "1191".

spl_setid.description: DailyMed Structured Product Label set id — UUID-shaped, for example "a1e07d5c-2056-46f3-8737-f03ed0b4bae8".

substance_name.description: Substance or ingredient name; a fuzzy name lookup when no identifier is known.

unii.description: FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier — exactly 10 letters or digits, for example "R16CO5Y76E".
